decisions.reason: The electrometer builds directly on the firm's core precision electronic measurement expertise, enabling effective learning and improvement.
Risk management software for oncology lies far outside the firm's existing electronic and optical knowledge, limiting its ability to assimilate and improve the product.
CT image quality phantoms extend the firm's measurement and optical capabilities into a related quality assurance domain, supporting absorptive capacity.
Mammography phantoms share knowledge with the firm's other imaging QA products, allowing shared learning and interpretation of results.
Full field mammography phantoms are closely related to the firm's mammography QA offerings, enabling the firm to apply existing knowledge.
Medical imaging QA instruments align with the firm's electronic measurement instruments, providing a strong base for absorbing new information.
